description_excerpt: Job Description • Troubleshoot machine to ensure continuous production time. • Monitor and support to finish complicated orders to be delivered on time. • Support other team members to meet output target as well as scrap rate. • Train new operators. • Monitor and report machines’ status, including: safety guarding, productivity, etc. to team lead and maintenance team to provide proper corrective action. • Sustain 5S at working area. • Support Engineer to setup and test new items, trial run. • Track/record spare parts, machines's consumables. • Others Tasks as supervisor required.…
